fields.marquee: Your turn to speak · Your turn to speak
fields.quote: “I understand, but I hesitate when I speak.”
fields.introHtml: Sound familiar? You don't need to know everything perfectly to practise speaking. A regular setting where you can use what you know, ask questions and get feedback is a good place to start.
fields.audienceHtml: This course is for learners who know the rules and the words but are looking for a chance to use them in conversation: those who know Arabic at least at A2 level and want speaking practice in the A2–B2 range. Groups are formed with similar levels in mind.

fields.name: Dr. Jehan Ziyad
fields.title: Senior Educator and Linguistics Specialist
fields.areas: Arabic Linguistics · Curriculum Development · Academic Leadership · Islamic Sciences
fields.bioHtml: Arabic is her native language. With her background in Arabic, Arabic literature and the Islamic sciences, she brings over 30 years of experience in face-to-face and online teaching.

credentials.text: Bachelor's degree in Arabic language and sciences and in the Islamic sciences.
Academic master's degree and doctorate in literary studies, specialising in Islamic literature.
Ijazah in teaching the recitation of the Holy Qur'an.
Face-to-face and online teaching experience at universities in Egypt and Saudi Arabia and in other educational settings.
Founder and director of ShukraanEdu Academy.

items.q: Is this course suitable for complete beginners?
items.aHtml: You need at least A2 level to join. Groups for A2, B1 and B2 participants are formed with similar levels in mind.

items.q: How many days a week will I attend?
items.aHtml: The Normal course meets one day a week and the Intensive course (+) two days a week. Each meeting has two 50-minute lessons with a 10-minute break in between. The Normal course is 8 lessons in 4 weeks; the Intensive course is 16 lessons in 4 weeks.

items.q: Do the two courses ever meet together?
items.aHtml: No. The intensive learners are further ahead, so the two courses never share a session.
When you complete your payment. You pay on this page, in the payment step of the registration form; right after that, your group's WhatsApp link and QR code are shown.

items.q: What if the times don't suit me?
items.aHtml: Message us once you have paid and joined the WhatsApp group; we will see whether the times can be changed. If we can't find a solution, your fee is refunded without delay.

items.q: What if I have a problem or a suggestion about the course?
items.aHtml: Write to us in the WhatsApp group: problems and suggestions are discussed there, and what we put into practice is decided by a vote.
